modelNotes: Team ratings come from score margins (capped at 25) with home advantage, fitted on this and last season with a 120-day half-life; last season counts 0.5x as much on top.
The rest of the regular season is simulated 20,000 times, letting team strength drift (more when more of the season is left), then the playoffs are simulated from each simulated table for title odds.

The table breaks ties on win percentage with the league's rules: head-to-head record, then record against teams at .500 or better, then head-to-head points difference, then points difference. Simulated seasons break ties at random.
The Commissioner's Cup final does not count in the standings and is left out; the Cup's group games do count.
Playoffs: series still to play are simulated 20,000 times from the regular-season ratings, starting from the real series scores.
